ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: As shown in the figure, point B is drawn such that $BE\perp x$ axis at point E. Let the side length of the diamond be $x$, \\
$\because B(8,4)$, \\
$\therefore CE=8-x$, $BE=4$, \\
In $\triangle CBE$, $CB^{2}=CE^{2}+BE^{2}$, \\
thus, $x^{2}=(8-x)^{2}+4^{2}$, solving for $x$ gives $x=\boxed{5}$, \\
$\therefore$ the side length of the diamond is \boxed{5}.
